summary.motive: Pair a true zone-read pull with a double-post shot so the run action buys the second level while the safety is forced to defend both deep middles alone.
summary.keyDefender: Free safety (single-high, caught between two posts)
summary.whyItWorks: The read makes the edge defend the quarterback, which freezes the linebackers on run fits, while two converging choice posts guarantee the lone deep defender picks the wrong lever.
summary.failureMode: The end squeezes rather than crashes, keeping the quarterback in the box, and the safety splits the posts from depth instead of committing.

beats.title: 1. The Read Sells the Give
beats.text: Five linemen fire inside-zone steps and the quarterback rides the mesh. The linebackers trigger downhill and even the nickel tips toward the box.

beats.title: 2. The Pull Punishes the Crash
beats.text: The read end crashes on the running back and the quarterback pulls instantly. With the edge vacated, he escapes clean and looks downfield.

beats.title: 3. Two Posts, One Safety
beats.text: Both boundary receivers climb vertically off choice releases and bend to the middle deep at staggered depths. The single-high safety has run eyes and two stems entering his vision.

beats.title: 4. The Deep Middle Surrenders
beats.text: The safety commits to the outside post and the inside post crosses free behind him. The quarterback delivers off the pulled read over the frozen second level.

relations.tell: The ball stays in the quarterback's hands after the mesh — a pure zone-read RPO would throw immediately off the read instead of pulling and climbing to set feet.
